import re
SRC = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<count>-|#+|=+|\$+|\d+\*?):\s*(?P<line>\d+):(?P<source>.*)$")
FUNC = re.compile(r"^function (?P<name>\S+) called (?P<called>\d+) returned (?P<returned>\S+) blocks executed (?P<blocks>\S+)$")
BRANCH = re.compile(r"^branch\s+(?P<branch>\d+) (?:taken (?P<taken>\S+)(?: \((?P<note>[^)]*)\))?|(?P<status>\S.*))$")
CALL = re.compile(r"^call\s+(?P<call>\d+) (?:returned (?P<returned>\S+)|(?P<status>\S.*))$")


def parse(lines):
    meta, funcs, branches, calls, src = {}, [], [], [], []
    ml, fl, bl, cl, sl = [], [], [], [], []
    function = ""
    pending = []
    line = ""
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = SRC.match(ln)
        if m:
            if m.group("line") == "0" and ":" in m.group("source"):
                k, v = m.group("source").split(":", 1)
                meta[k] = v
                ml.append(i)
                continue
            line = m.group("line")
            for f in pending:
                f["line"] = line
            pending = []
            src.append({"line": line, "count": m.group("count"), "function": function, "source": m.group("source")})
            sl.append(i)
            continue
        m = FUNC.match(ln)
        if m:
            function = m.group("name")
            row = {"function": function, "line": "", "called": m.group("called"),
                   "returned": m.group("returned"), "blocks executed": m.group("blocks")}
            funcs.append(row)
            pending.append(row)
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = BRANCH.match(ln)
        if m:
            branches.append({"line": line, "function": function, "branch": m.group("branch"),
                             "taken": m.group("taken") or "", "note": m.group("note") or m.group("status") or ""})
            bl.append(i)
            continue
        m = CALL.match(ln)
        if m:
            calls.append({"line": line, "function": function, "call": m.group("call"),
                          "returned": m.group("returned") or "", "note": m.group("status") or ""})
            cl.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = [
        {"name": "metadata", "kind": "kv", "lines": ml, "records": [meta]},
        {"name": "functions", "kind": "table", "lines": fl, "records": funcs},
        {"name": "source", "kind": "table", "lines": sl, "records": src},
        {"name": "branches", "kind": "table", "lines": bl, "records": branches},
        {"name": "calls", "kind": "table", "lines": cl, "records": calls},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": []}
